verdict.rationale: Postmark's documented webhook protection relies on HTTP Basic Authentication, IP allowlisting, and payload shape validation. The evidence never shows signed payloads or signature-verification code. Those mechanisms are adjacent authenticity controls, not the signed-payload verification this story requires, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify webhook authenticity — signed payloads with documented signature verification code — so spoofed events can't poison my delivery state

citations.quote: Node/TypeScript HTTP Basic Authentication, IP allowlisting, payload shape validation
